rule.name: PlainCollectionInConcurrentMap
rule.message: A value of this concurrent map is a plain collection (ArrayList, HashSet, HashMap and the like) that is changed after computeIfAbsent returns it, so two threads that add under the same key change it at once: elements are lost, a reader throws ConcurrentModificationException and a HashMap can corrupt. Store a concurrent value (ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet(), CopyOnWriteArrayList, new ConcurrentHashMap<>()), change it inside compute or merge, or lock around every read and write of the value. An exception fits a map that only one thread uses.
